description: Adversarially audit a decision for cognitive biases. Returns a directive YOUR model executes to produce the composed audit (verdict-first). Provide reasoning, not just the conclusion.

language.description: Optional. Natural language for the audit prose (e.g. "Tamil", "Spanish"). Bias ids stay canonical English so the result is still parseable. Defaults to English.

mode.description: forward = a decision you are about to make; retrospective = reviewing a past decision/outcome.

reasoning.description: How you arrived at it (required to audit).

structured.description: Optional. Default false → the audit comes back as readable prose. Set true to get a machine-parseable JSON object (bias ids/keys in English) for pipelines that store or compare audits.

name: analyze_decision
